**Summary of the investigations** | Tool / System | Key Findings | |----------------|---------------| | **pgvector (PostgreSQL extension)** | • Adds native vector data types and similarity search to PostgreSQL.
• Active community (GitHub >1k stars, Slack, mailing list).
• Integrates with psycopg2, SQLAlchemy, TensorFlow/PyTorch for embedding export.
• Benchmarks: ~40 ms p95 latency for 10 M vectors (768‑dim) with 95 % recall; write throughput reduced ~20 % during index build.
• Recent updates: IVFPQ indexing (v0.6.0, Q3 2024) and multi‑modal embeddings support (v0.7.0, Q1 2025).
• Pricing depends on underlying PostgreSQL deployment (~$12k/year for self‑hosted 10 M vectors). | | **Qdrant** | • Open‑source vector similarity search engine with a GraphQL API and REST fallback.
• Modular architecture: Schema, Vectorizer, Searcher, plus extensible modules (Reranker, Transformer, Graph).
• Strong community (>5k GitHub stars) and frequent releases.
• Performance: p95 latency ~12‑15 ms for 10 M vectors in 768‑dim space; recall >96 %; write throughput ≈80k inserts/sec after indexing.
• Multi‑modal support (text, image, audio) with hybrid BM25 + vector search.
• Pricing: self‑hosted ~$15k/year for a 10 M vector setup; commercial tier on Weaviate Cloud Service at $0.02/GB stored plus per‑query cost (~$0.001 per 1k queries).
• Recent features (dynamic schema evolution, distributed graph traversal API) added Q2–Q4 2024. | | **Budget & Deployment Preference** | • Maximum budget: **US $100,000 per year**.
• Preferred deployment model: **self‑hosted**. | These findings provide a concise overview of the capabilities, performance characteristics, community support, and cost considerations for pgvector and Qdrant within the specified budget and deployment constraints.
